ApiError.description: Partial error returned alongside valid data in 200 responses.

type.description: URI identifying the error type (problem-details style).

Includes.description: Expanded objects included alongside the primary data.

posts.description: Post objects referenced by `referenced_posts`. X may send this under its legacy name `tweets`; either name fills this field.

Post.description:
A post object from the X API v2.

Required fields: `id`, `text` (always present in API responses).
Optional fields depend on which `post.fields` the caller requests.

attachments.description: Media / poll attachment references — opaque JSON.

author_id.description: Author's user ID; resolve via `includes.users` when expanded.

conversation_id.description: Root post ID of the conversation thread.

created_at.description: ISO-8601 timestamp the post was created.

entities.description: Parsed entities (URLs, mentions, hashtags) — opaque JSON.

in_reply_to_user_id.description: User ID this post replies to, when applicable.

referenced_posts.description: Posts this one references (reply, quote, repost). X may send this under its legacy name `referenced_tweets`; either name fills this field.

PostPublicMetrics.description: Public engagement metrics for a post.

repost_count.description: Repost count. X may send this under its legacy name `retweet_count`; either name fills this field.

next_token.description:
Opaque cursor for the next page; pass it back as the follow-up
request's cursor.

previous_token.description: Opaque cursor for the previous page.

result_count.description: Total items returned in `data` for list endpoints.

User.description:
A user object from the X API v2.

Required fields: `id`, `name`, `username`.
Optional fields depend on which `user.fields` the caller requests.

active_follower_count.description:
Followers active on X in the last 24 hours. X returns it only for the
authenticated user with account analytics enabled, omits it for an
account with 50 or fewer followers, and estimates it from 20,000 up.

verified.description: Whether the account carries a verified badge.

UserPublicMetrics.description: Public engagement metrics for a user.

listed_count.description: Number of public lists the user is on.

post_count.description: Post count for the user. X sends this under its legacy name `tweet_count`; either name fills this field.

UserSettings.description:
The authenticated user's account settings.

Every field is optional because the spec requires none of them.

allow_dms_from.description:
Who may send the user direct messages: `all`, `verified`, or
`following` (accounts the user follows).

allow_media_tagging.description: Who may tag the user in media: `all`, `following`, or `none`.

always_allow_dms_from_subscribers.description:
Whether the user's subscribers may always message them, whatever
`allow_dms_from` says.

discoverable_by_email.description: Whether people with the user's email address can find them on X.

discoverable_by_phone.description: Whether people with the user's phone number can find them on X.

display_sensitive_media.description: Whether media that may be sensitive is shown to the user.

id.description: The id of the user the settings belong to.

language.description: The account's language, a BCP 47 tag such as `en` or `pt-BR`.

location_tagging_enabled.description: Whether a precise location may be attached to the user's posts.

personalized_trends.description:
Whether the user's trends are personalized. X sets it; no update
changes it.

protected.description:
Whether the user's posts are protected, visible only to approved
followers.

quiet_hours.description: The daily window with no push or SMS notifications.

time_zone.description: The time zone the account is set to.

use_cookie_personalization.description:
Whether X may use the user's activity off X to personalize what
they see.

UserSettingsQuietHours.description: The daily window in which the user gets no push or SMS notifications.

end_hour.description: The hour quiet hours end, 0 to 23 in the user's time zone.

start_hour.description: The hour quiet hours begin, 0 to 23 in the user's time zone.

UserSettingsTimeZone.description: The time zone an account is set to.

name.description:
The name the zone was set with: an IANA name such as
`America/Los_Angeles`, or a display name such as
`Pacific Time (US & Canada)`.

utc_offset_seconds.description: The zone's offset from UTC now, in seconds.

description: Standard X API v2 response envelope. `data` holds one object for single-item endpoints and an array for list endpoints.

data.description: Primary payload: one object, or an array for list endpoints.

errors.description: Partial errors returned alongside a 200 response.

includes.description:
Expanded objects referenced by `data` when the caller requested
`expansions=...`.
